articles.title: Moulton: Hegseth 'Guilty' of War Crimes Like Nazi Submarine Captains
articles.summary: US Congressman Seth Moulton (D-MA) accused a high-ranking US defence official, identified in the report as 'Secretary of War Pete Hegseth,' of committing war crimes during a CNN interview. These grave allegations, made by a combat veteran, prompt significant questions regarding accountability, military ethics, and adherence to international law within America's defence leadership and policy framework.

articles.title: USS-Scorpion: Two Nuclear Torpedoes Still Sit 3,000 Meters Down — And Nobody Can Retrieve Them
articles.summary: The USS Scorpion, a US Navy submarine, sank decades ago, leaving two nuclear torpedoes irretrievably submerged at an astonishing depth of 3,000 meters. These dangerous munitions pose long-term environmental and safety concerns due to the difficulty of recovery. This enduring incident highlights persistent challenges associated with lost nuclear assets at sea, impacting future naval strategies and historical salvage efforts.

articles.title: USS Thresher Mystery FINALLY Solved—And It's Worse Than Anyone Imagine
articles.summary: The U.S. Navy's advanced nuclear submarine, Thresher, conducted a routine deep dive test in the Atlantic Ocean off Cape Cod. This critical exercise for the sophisticated submarine involved a rescue ship for monitoring and safety. Such rigorous testing is vital for ensuring the operational readiness and capabilities of strategic naval assets, reflecting continuous advancements in defence technology.

articles.title: Flights resume at Jodhpur runway as IAF’s Dornier lands after runway upgrade
articles.summary: Flights have resumed at Jodhpur runway following a significant upgrade. The operational return was marked by a successful landing of an Indian Air Force (IAF) Dornier aircraft. This development not only enhances regional air connectivity but also plays a crucial role in bolstering military aviation capabilities and defence infrastructure, vital for national security and strategic operations.

articles.title: Reporter’s Notebook: King Charles’ visit puts fraying US-UK alliance in the spotlight
articles.summary: In spring 1991, amidst popular culture, Queen Elizabeth II achieved a historic milestone by becoming the first British monarch to address a Joint Meeting of the U.S. Congress. This significant diplomatic event underscored the unique relationship between the United Kingdom and the United States, marking a pivotal moment in bilateral international relations and royal history.
